Python with comments, verify comment count

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"comments\":true,\"language\":\"python\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "# This is a comment\n# Another comment\ndef hello():\n    # inline comment\n    pass\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language())
debugPrint(result.comments())
```
